title: 1997. First Day Where You Have Been in All the Rooms

examples.explanation: - On day 0, you visit room 0. The total times you have been in room 0 is 1, which is odd. On the next day you will visit room nextVisit[0] = 0 - On day 1, you visit room 0, The total times you have been in room 0 is 2, which is even. On the next day you will visit room (0 + 1) mod 2 = 1 - On day 2, you visit room 1. This is the first day where you have been in all the rooms.
Your room visiting order for each day is: [0,0,1,0,0,1,2,...]. Day 6 is the first day where you have been in all the rooms.

hints: The only way to get to room i+1 is when you are visiting room i and room i has been visited an even number of times.

After visiting room i an odd number of times, you are required to visit room nextVisit[i] where nextVisit[i] <= i. It takes a fixed amount of days for you to come back from room nextVisit[i] to room i. Then, you have visited room i even number of times.nextVisit[i]
